title: Recovering a segment by reading values
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of integers whose entries are the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$. Then $l$ is exactly the list of values $\mu(a),\mu(a+1),\ldots,\mu(a+|l|-1)$, where $|l|$ denotes the length of $l$.
hypotheses_covered: The entries of $l$ equal the values of $\mu$ starting at $a$
